detail.longDescription: The browser new tab is opened dozens of times a day and most people waste it on a blank page or a news feed. The sweet spot is ambient information: stuff useful enough to glance at, not engaging enough to distract you. Time, weather, world clocks. Wrote about why this matters and how to set it up: https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/what-t o-put-on-your-browsers-new-tab-the-case-for-ambient-information-5385 # Productivity # Firefox # NewTab
